# GitHub Copilot Repository Instructions

For any website page, UI, or styling work, load and follow @STYLE_GUIDE.md as the sole visual source of truth.

- The style guide is derived exclusively from the pasted Lifestyle Session HTML reference.
- Existing pages are content sources and restyling targets, not design references.
- Preserve accurate page-specific content, metadata, approved images, prices, packages, and destinations unless explicitly asked to change them.
- Never invent business facts, assets, image URLs, or links.
- Keep pages Hebrew RTL and preserve the standalone HTML plus Tailwind CDN architecture unless explicitly directed otherwise.
- Do not introduce visual patterns absent from the guide without explicit user direction.
- Preserve unrelated user changes.
- Before completion, compare the result with the guide and verify responsive layout, RTL flow, links, accessibility, and reduced motion.

Follow @AGENTS.md as the repository-wide operating instructions.
